title: Storage yes/no
question: Should the plant include thermal storage?

options.label: No seasonal storage
options.notes: candidates: C1-3d, C2-2d, C3-2d, C5-3d, C7-2d, C8-3d; excluded by DesignGuard/verifier: C4-2d; top-ranked (LCOH ranking)

criterion.text: lowest lcoh_per_mwh + lcoc_per_mwh among guard-passed candidates without unmet demand in economics

rationale: The criterion 'ranking-lowest-lcoh_per_mwh' identifies 'no-storage' as the best option. This aligns with the economics evidence showing superior LCOH and LCOC metrics for the no-storage configuration compared to seasonal HT-ATES.
